description: This file defines a React component for a compact, virtualized table with sorting, empty states, loading indicators, and customizable columns. It includes subcomponents for headers, empty states, skeleton loading, and rows, and manages data virtualization for performance.

methods.name: SortableHeaderCell
methods.description: A React component rendering a header cell that can toggle sorting order when clicked.

methods.name: StaticHeaderCell
methods.description: A React component rendering a static header cell, typically for non-sortable columns.

methods.name: CompactTable
methods.description: Main React component rendering a virtualized, sortable table with customizable columns, row click handling, and support for empty/loading states.
